sql:
SELECT `School Name`, `District Ownership Code Type`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  );

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';
label: ok

sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';
label: ok

JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

sql:
SELECT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Brands Hatch' AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year, r.round
LIMIT 1;
label: ok

FROM results r

JOIN circuits c ON rac.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND c.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix';

sql:
SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP = '2+'
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250;
